```{r publications, echo=FALSE}
src <- paste(readLines("../Papers.Rmd", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
start <- regexpr("<!--html_preserve-->", src, fixed = TRUE)
end <- regexpr("<!--/html_preserve-->", src, fixed = TRUE)
stopifnot(start > 0, end > start)
block <- substr(src, start + nchar("<!--html_preserve-->"), end - 1)

# Translate the page's own labels; paper titles, authors and venues stay as published.
labels <- c(
  "<h1>Papers</h1>" = "<h1>Publicaciones</h1>",
  "Peer-reviewed journal articles, book chapters and working papers." =
    "Artículos en revistas arbitradas, capítulos de libro y documentos de trabajo.",
  'aria-label="Sections"' = 'aria-label="Secciones"',
  ">Journal articles" = ">Artículos en revistas",
  ">Book chapters" = ">Capítulos de libro",
  ">Working papers" = ">Documentos de trabajo",
  "Spanish edition:" = "Edición en español:",
  ">First Place</span>" = ">Primer lugar</span>",
  'href="docs/' = 'href="../docs/'
)
for (from in names(labels)) block <- gsub(from, labels[[from]], block, fixed = TRUE)
htmltools::HTML(block)
```
